features.text: CUSTOM BEND-TO-FIT DESIGN: Adjusts easily for personalized knee alignment and comfort.
PROGRESSIVE EXTENSION ANGLE: Pre-set at 10° to gently stretch for contracture therapy.
LIGHTWEIGHT DURABLE FRAME: Supports long-term use with ergonomic comfort.
UNIVERSAL APPLICATION: Suitable for right or left knee, mild to severe conditions.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
